spans.s: --a companion of Puramjana, allegorically the organ of speech (see मुख्या). भा. IV. २५. ४९; २९. ११.
--a god of the ten branches of the सुकर्माण group of devas. Br.
--a class of पिशाचस्: nude and drinkers of blood in the field of battle. Br.
--a पिशाच gan2a, drink the blood shed in wars. Br.

(I)--visited by बलराम;
1: भा. X. ७९. ११.
R. of the प्लक्षद्वीप,
2: Br. II. १९. १९; Vi.

. ११; III. १४. १८.
from the हिमालयस्,
3: Br. II. १६. २५.
in भारतवर्ष;
4: Ib. II. १२. १५; वा. ४५. ९६, ९९.
sacred to अमोघाक्षी and the पितृस्.
5: M. १३. ३५; २२. २३.

(II)--one of the १६ wives of हव्यवाहन;
1: M. ५१. १४; वा. २९. १४.
in the chariot of त्रिपुरारि.
2: M. १३३. २३.
--ety. one who is void of द्वन्द्व, happiness and misery, cold and heat, etc. वा. 4. २८.
(I)--a son of Vasudeva and रोहिणी. भा. IX. २४. ४६.

(II)--a Mt. sacred to विपुला; a विष्कम्भपर्- vata,
1: M. १३. ३६; वा. ३५. १६.
to the west of इलावृत.
2: Vi.

(II)--the सभा of Kubera; description of; here is पुष्पक, the विमान; around are the ten cities of the Gandharvas in the east, thirty cities of the यक्षस् in the west, and a hundred cities of the Kinnaras in the south. वा. ४१. 5-११, २०, २४, २७-8.
(II)--a son of अश्विनी and अक्रूर. M. ४५. ३२.
--a son of Vasudeva and धृतदेवा. भा. IX. २४. ५०.
(I)--a son of सृतंजय, and father of शुचि. भा. IX. २२. ४७; Vi. IV. २३. 5.
(II)--a son of शिष्टि and सुच्छाया. Vi. I. १३. 2.

--chief among the १०० sons of Danu, married सिम्हिका who bore one hundred and one sons col- lectively called Simhikeyas. Father of राहु; a follower of वृत्र in his battle with Indra. Took part in the देवासुर [page३-245+ २९] war between Bali and Indra, but was asked by Bali to refrain from battle;
1: भा.

. १०७; १५. १४१; २१. 6, १०-12.
in the सभा of हिरण्यकशिपु;
2: M. १६१. ७९.
in the churn- ing of the ocean;
3: Ib. २४५. ३१; २४९. ६७.
in the guise of a standard killed by Mahen- dra in कोलाहला war:
4: Ib. ४७. ५२.
the overlord of the दानवस्; the brother of Dhvaja who was killed by Indra; had his aim in the ध्वज or standard.
5: Br.
(I)--an Apsaras with the sun in Hemanta. वा. ५२. १८.
